verified_results: GRADE [R] Root statement: OAI.EuclideanFiveColor.no_proper_five_coloring : ¬ ∃ c : ℂ → Fin 5, ProperColoring 5 c (Geometry/PlaneColoring/Five.lean:133), with ProperColoring (k : ℕ) (c : ℂ → Fin k) : Prop := ∀ x y : ℂ, ‖x - y‖ = 1 → c x ≠ c y (Coloring.lean:7).

GRADE [R] Vertex domain is the whole complex plane (all of ℝ²); the edge predicate is Euclidean distance EXACTLY 1; the colouring is a total arbitrary function into Fin 5. No measurability, boundedness, definability or a.e. reading appears in the claim.

GRADE [R] Measurability, choice and conditional hypotheses are proof-side only: proper_to_borel_weak_algebraic (BorelTransfer.lean:439) produces a measurable WeakColoring from a proper labelling of the algebraic plane, and no_measurable_weak_five_coloring (Five.lean:105) closes the argument. WeakColoring is defined at Coloring.lean:27 and is never mentioned in a public root statement.

GRADE [R] The algebraic plane E = algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ (Analysis/PlaneSpectrum/Basic.lean:9) appears only as a proof intermediate via LabelModel.Proper (Representations.lean:55) and no_proper_five_coloring_algebraic (Five.lean:126). The passage to E in the root proof is a restriction, `⟨fun x => c x, fun x y h => hc x y h⟩`, definitionally transparent because the coercion sits outside the subtraction.

GRADE [R] The bundle vocabulary is PROVEN equivalent, not assumed: Problem160.planeProperColoring_iff (Chromatic.lean:92) gives ProperColoring k ↔ ∃ d : ℂ → Fin k, EuclideanFiveColor.ProperColoring k d using toPlane/ofPlane and dist_ofPlane. Problem160.ProperColoring is ∃ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Fin k, ∀ x y, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y (Basic.lean:26).

GRADE [R] The displayed inequality is chromaticNumber_bounds : 6 ≤ planeChromaticNumber ∧ planeChromaticNumber ≤ 7 (Chromatic.lean:136) with planeChromaticNumber := sInf {k | ProperColoring k} (Basic.lean:40).

GRADE [C] NO MISMATCH with unrestricted Hadwiger–Nelson identified: full plane, exact unit distance, unrestricted total colouring, conclusion χ ≥ 6 and χ ≤ 7. Two referee caveats recorded rather than glossed: Nat.sInf needs the set inhabited for the numeric claim (discharged by properColoring_seven), and Fin 0 makes ProperColoring 0 false, covered by monotonicity.

GRADE [C] The encoding-core edits touch the PROOF route to no_proper_five_coloring (Five is reverse-dependent via Approximation → ConditionalSpectrum) but not its STATEMENT: no encoding predicate, IsWild or conditional kernel occurs in any of the three root statements.

GRADE [R] Signature-packet limitation RESOLVED by construction, not by argument: SignatureCheckFresh.lean declares no section variables, binds StandardBorelSpace Y and Nonempty Y as PLAIN hypotheses (never instance-implicit, so not in the instance cache), and applies each theorem with only explicit arguments. An added omitted-Y binder must then fail synthesis. A letI positive control distinguishes 'theorem regressed' from 'test file wrong'.

GRADE [S] Supervisor-reported and not re-run: R4 source hashes now match on both VM and local; SignatureEquivalence R4 is staged but uncompiled; the full 82 build is still running and no queue edits are allowed. The claim is therefore NOT reported as locally verified.
